Agc.description:
FLIR's AGC: one equalisation, with or without its information-based mode, and
a share of linear ramp. Defaults are a Boson+'s factory settings, Product
Datasheet 102-2013-45 Rev 100 §6.8; the presets in `cfg/agc` are FLIR's for its
Boson-based M364C LR.

information_based.title: Information Based
information_based.description: Weight detail up in the histogram and add it back on top, so a hull's edges take greys a smooth sea or sky would; off, plain plateau equalisation.

plateau.title: Plateau
plateau.description: The most pixels one histogram bin counts, as a fraction of the frame.

linear_fraction.title: Linear Fraction
linear_fraction.description: The share of the grey range spread evenly over the frame's temperatures; the rest follows its histogram. 1 is a linear stretch.

max_gain.title: Max Gain
max_gain.description: The steepest the transfer curve may be, in grey levels per centikelvin, so noise on a bland frame stays grain.

tau_s.title: Tau S
tau_s.description: How fast the curve follows the frame.

smoothing.title: Smoothing
smoothing.description: Information-based only: the edge-preserving filter's range sigma, in centikelvin; a step well past it stays background rather than detail.

detail_headroom.title: Detail Headroom
detail_headroom.description: Information-based only: grey levels kept free at each end for the detail, so a sharpened edge does not clip.

dde.title: Dde
dde.description: Information-based only: gain on the detail, below 1 smoothing, above 1 sharpening.

Agc.title: Agc

band.description: The band it sees in: eo visible, ir LWIR.

yaw_deg.title: Yaw Deg
yaw_deg.description: Relative to the rig's axis, positive to starboard.

pitch_deg.title: Pitch Deg
pitch_deg.description: Relative to the rig, negative is down.

hfov_deg.title: Hfov Deg
hfov_deg.description: Measured across the image width, even in portrait.

agc.description: How an ir jpg, and the montage, panorama and video of an ir png, turn temperature into grey.

Drift.description:
A hull at single anchor fishtails: across its heading once a period, along it
twice. Starts at its pose; the heading holds.
Drift.title: Drift

Farm.description:
Turbines in rows of equal length, each to starboard of the last along
`row_bearing_deg`. One row of one is a lone turbine.

asset.title: Asset
asset.description: An asset name from the manifest: `seascape assets list` shows them. A turbine.

range_m.title: Range M
range_m.description: To the first turbine of the first row.

bearing_deg.title: Bearing Deg
bearing_deg.description: Of the first turbine, clockwise from the ownship's bow.

spacing_d.title: Spacing D
spacing_d.description: Along a row, then between rows, in rotor diameters.

row_bearing_deg.title: Row Bearing Deg
row_bearing_deg.description: Where a row runs from its first turbine, clockwise from the ownship's bow.

staggered.title: Staggered
staggered.description: Every other row shifted half a spacing along.

paint_absorptance.title: Paint Absorptance
paint_absorptance.description: Solar absorptance of the paint on its hull, superstructure and funnel: white low, black high. Unset, a mid grey. IR only, with zones.

Farm.title: Farm

Heave.description: A sinusoid about the waterline, starting at it.
Heave.title: Heave

Lens.description: What the optics do beyond the pinhole.

vignetting.title: Vignetting
vignetting.description: Natural falloff, cos^4 of the field angle.

Lens.title: Lens

Microbolometer.description: An uncooled LWIR camera's focal plane and lens aperture. Unset, it is ideal.

netd_k.title: Netd K
netd_k.description: Temporal noise: one standard deviation against a 30 C scene.

f_number.title: F Number
f_number.description: The lens's f-number, for its diffraction.

Microbolometer.title: Microbolometer

asset.title: Asset
asset.description: An asset name from the manifest: `seascape assets list` shows them.

heading_from.title: Heading From
heading_from.description: What `heading_deg` turns from: the ownship's bow, or the line from the ownship to it, where 0 points away and 180 towards.

t_k.title: T K
t_k.description: One temperature for the whole hull, warmed by `sky.solar_gain_k` in sun. Unset, each zone settles at its own heat balance. IR only.

engine_off_min.title: Engine Off Min
engine_off_min.description: Minutes since its engines stopped; 0 is running. The engine room and exhaust cool toward the air. IR only, with zones.

paint_absorptance.title: Paint Absorptance
paint_absorptance.description: Solar absorptance of the paint on its hull, superstructure and funnel: white low, black high. Unset, a mid grey. IR only, with zones.

count.title: Count
count.description: How many, each drawn anew. `load` makes the copies, so a loaded scenario holds only 1.

Orbit.description:
Round the ownship's origin clockwise from the hull's bearing, at its range, bow
along the circle.

Identical hulls share the lap evenly, so a loop need only last `period_s / count`.
Orbit.title: Orbit

Outputs.description:
What a render writes.

Every camera of a listed band is rendered. An EO png or jpg is 8-bit, as a camera
with auto-exposure takes it. An LWIR png is 16-bit, a hundredth of a kelvin per
count; an LWIR jpg is 8-bit grey, auto-contrasted as a thermal camera does. An exr
keeps the radiance, in W m^-2 sr^-1.

bands.title: Bands
bands.description: Bands to render; one with no camera is skipped.

format.description: jpg to look at, png lossless or LWIR in kelvin, exr the radiance. Only an 8-bit frame is judged for visibility: an exr or LWIR png boxes every target in view.

exposure_compensation_ev.title: Exposure Compensation Ev
exposure_compensation_ev.description: Stops over auto-exposure. Applies to 8-bit EO only.

fps.title: Fps
fps.description: Frames per second of a sequence.

loop.title: Loop
loop.description: Repeats seamlessly: each period rounds to a whole fraction of duration_s.

keep_if_any_sees.title: Keep If Any Sees
keep_if_any_sees.description: Boxes a target in every camera of a band that has it in frame, at an instant when any of them sees it.

Outputs.title: Outputs

Ownship.description:
The vessel the rig is bolted to, rolling and pitching about its origin at the
waterline. Without an asset it is the attitude alone.

asset.title: Asset
asset.description: An asset name from the manifest: `seascape assets list` shows them.

t_k.title: T K
t_k.description: One temperature for the whole hull, warmed by `sky.solar_gain_k` in sun. Unset, each zone settles at its own heat balance. IR only.

Ownship.title: Ownship

Processing.description: The camera's ISP. White balance and sharpening need a sensor.

exposure_ev.title: Exposure Ev
exposure_ev.description: Stops over auto-exposure, on top of outputs.exposure_compensation_ev.

white_balance_k.title: White Balance K
white_balance_k.description: How far the camera's guess of the light misses D65's 6504 K, along the Planckian locus. Positive guesses bluer light, so the frame comes out warmer.

Processing.title: Processing

Rig.description:
One installed product: the frame its cameras sit in, at one mount point.

Rigs a beam apart overlap in angle before they overlap in space, which leaves a
blind wedge over the bow; coincident cameras would hide it.

model.title: Model
model.description: The product, such as Pod. A recording needs it.

yaw_deg.title: Yaw Deg
yaw_deg.description: Its axis relative to the bow, positive to starboard.

pitch_deg.title: Pitch Deg
pitch_deg.description: About its own transverse axis, after its yaw and before its cameras'. Negative is down.

offset_x_m.title: Offset X M
offset_x_m.description: From the centreline, positive to starboard.

near_clip_m.title: Near Clip M
near_clip_m.description: Anything nearer a camera is not rendered.

Rig.title: Rig

Samples.description:
Cycles samples per band.

A model so an override merges field by field; a dict would replace it whole
and drop the band left out.
Samples.title: Samples

Sea.description:
The temperature bound is the span of the shipped optical-constant table. `lwir`
clamps to it; here it is an error.

t_sea_k.title: T Sea K
t_sea_k.description: Bulk sea temperature, under the skin the camera sees. IR only. Unset, the atmosphere's own.

warm_layer.description: A day's sun trapped near the surface, warming the skin. IR only. Opt-in: the sun's elevation does not say how long it has shone.

wind_speed_mps.title: Wind Speed Mps
wind_speed_mps.description: Measured 10 m above the sea. Sets the wind sea.

wind_from_deg.title: Wind From Deg
wind_from_deg.description: Where the wind blows from, clockwise from the ownship's bow.

fetch_km.title: Fetch Km
fetch_km.description: How far the wind has blown over open water: the shorter, the smaller and shorter its waves. Unset, the open ocean, with no limit.

swell.description: On top of the wind's sea.

chlorophyll_mg_m3.title: Chlorophyll Mg M3
chlorophyll_mg_m3.description: Chlorophyll in the water. Sets its colour, from clear blue to a green bloom.

slick_cover.title: Slick Cover
slick_cover.description: Fraction of the sea under slicks, gathered in windrows. None in calm air, where slick and clean water are one.

refraction_k.title: Refraction K
refraction_k.description: Coefficient of terrestrial refraction; 0 is none.

Sea.title: Sea

Sensor.description:
What a pixel does with the light that reaches it, in EMVA 1288's terms. Without
a full well the camera is ideal.

gain_db.title: Gain Db
gain_db.description: Analogue gain: fewer electrons fill the ADC.

width_px.title: Width Px
width_px.description: Its columns, if more than the image's. At twice or more, the ISP demosaics and scales down, so each pixel averages its sites; below, the sensor reads at the image's pitch.

hdr_ratio.title: Hdr Ratio
hdr_ratio.description: 1 takes one exposure, which clips; above it, a second one this many times shorter, merged and tone-mapped.

Sensor.title: Sensor

Sky.description:
Blender's Sky Texture or a photographed sky in EO, and the downwelling radiance
the sea reflects in IR.

Haze is `visibility_km`, in the air between the camera and what it sees, in both
bands. In LWIR, `atmosphere` adds its water vapour, shapes the sky, and gives
`t_air_k` unless it is set.

sun_elevation_deg.title: Sun Elevation Deg
sun_elevation_deg.description: Above the horizon; negative is below it. With `hdri`, set from the photo, and None where its sun shows no disc.

solar_gain_k.title: Solar Gain K
solar_gain_k.description: How much warmer a sunlit surface is than a shaded one, on a hull given one `t_k`. IR only.

visibility_km.title: Visibility Km
visibility_km.description: Meteorological range at 550 nm; None is no aerosol.

atmosphere.description: LOWTRAN 7's model atmosphere, or the North Sea's, for the LWIR sky and air. EO ignores it. subarctic_winter's horizon partly sees space, so its horizon sky reads warmer than LOWTRAN's.

t_air_k.title: T Air K
t_air_k.description: Scales the IR sky. EO ignores it. Unset, the atmosphere's own.

cloud_base_m.title: Cloud Base M
cloud_base_m.description: The photo's cloud base, which sets its clouds' temperature in IR. EO ignores it.

hdri.title: Hdri
hdri.description: A photographed sky from seascape/assets/skies.toml, in place of the Sky Texture, which sets `sun_elevation_deg`. LWIR keeps its own clear sky and takes the photo's sun and clouds, turned to `sun_bearing_deg`.

Sky.title: Sky

Swell.description: Waves from a distant storm, whatever the local wind.

from_deg.title: From Deg
from_deg.description: Where it comes from, clockwise from the ownship's bow.

Swell.title: Swell

Swing.description: A sinusoid about the mean attitude, starting at the mean.
Swing.title: Swing

Targets.description:
A ring of vessels at one range, spread over a span of bearings.

Placed in the world, so nothing guarantees a camera sees one.

asset.title: Asset
asset.description: An asset name from the manifest: `seascape assets list` shows them. A list is taken in turn round the ring.

bearing_deg.title: Bearing Deg
bearing_deg.description: First and last, clockwise from the ownship's bow. Both ends get a target.

heading_deg.title: Heading Deg
heading_deg.description: First and last, spread evenly, clockwise from the ownship's bow.

t_k.title: T K
t_k.description: One temperature for the whole hull, warmed by `sky.solar_gain_k` in sun. Unset, each zone settles at its own heat balance. IR only.

engine_off_min.title: Engine Off Min
engine_off_min.description: Minutes since its engines stopped; 0 is running. The engine room and exhaust cool toward the air. IR only, with zones.

paint_absorptance.title: Paint Absorptance
paint_absorptance.description: Solar absorptance of the paint on its hull, superstructure and funnel: white low, black high. Unset, a mid grey. IR only, with zones.

Targets.title: Targets

WarmLayer.description:
The sun's heat trapped near the surface on a calm day, Fairall et al.'s warm
layer. Each value is a mean since it formed; unset, their clear COARE day's.

hours.title: Hours
hours.description: How long the sun has heated it, from just after sunrise.

cooling_w_m2.title: Cooling W M2
cooling_w_m2.description: Net cooling at the surface, longwave, sensible and latent. Unset, a clear COARE day's at the sea's wind.

WarmLayer.title: WarmLayer

Uniform.description: A float drawn evenly between two bounds.
Uniform.title: Uniform

LogUniform.description:
A float drawn evenly in its logarithm between two bounds: as often between 0.1
and 1 as between 1 and 10.
LogUniform.title: LogUniform

Triangular.description: A float drawn from a triangular density peaking at the mode, a bound or not.

triangular.description: The lower bound, the mode and the upper bound.
triangular.title: Triangular

Triangular.title: Triangular

Integer.description: A whole number drawn evenly between two bounds.
Integer.title: Integer

Choice.description: One of several values, each as likely unless weighted.

weights.description: How likely each value is, relative to the others: [8, 2] is 80 and 20 percent.
weights.title: Weights

Choice.title: Choice

OpticalDepth.description:
An object's `range_m` as optical depth: a ray keeps exp(-depth) of its light,
with `sky.visibility_km` taken as Koschmieder's 2%.

optical_depth.description: The bounds, lower first, drawn evenly.
optical_depth.title: Optical Depth
